# Media Upload & Download

## Upload Media

Mataram support upload dari URL, stream, atau Buffer.

### Cara upload

```ts
await sock.sendMessage(jid, {
  image: { url: 'https://example.com/foto.jpg' },  // dari URL
  // image: fs.createReadStream('./foto.jpg'),       // dari Stream
  // image: fs.readFileSync('./foto.jpg'),            // dari Buffer
  caption: 'Caption foto'
})
```

## Download Media

### Dapatkan stream

```ts
import { downloadContentFromMessage } from '@mataram/wa'

sock.ev.on('messages.upsert', async ({ messages }) => {
  for (const msg of messages) {
    if (!msg.message) continue

    const type = Object.keys(msg.message)[0] // imageMessage, videoMessage, dll
    const media = msg.message[type]

    if (media) {
      const stream = await downloadContentFromMessage(media, type.replace('Message', ''))
      const buffer = []
      for await (const chunk of stream) {
        buffer.push(chunk)
      }
      const data = Buffer.concat(buffer)
      console.log('Downloaded:', data.length, 'bytes')
    }
  }
})
```

### Simpan ke file

```ts
import { createWriteStream } from 'fs'
import { downloadContentFromMessage } from '@mataram/wa'

const stream = await downloadContentFromMessage(media, 'image')
const file = createWriteStream('./foto.jpg')
stream.pipe(file)

file.on('finish', () => console.log('Foto tersimpan'))
```

### Fungsi utility `downloadMediaMessage`

```ts
import { downloadMediaMessage } from '@mataram/wa'

// Download sebagai buffer
const buffer = await downloadMediaMessage(msg, 'buffer')

// Download sebagai stream
const stream = await downloadMediaMessage(msg, 'stream')
```

## Generate Thumbnail

Butuh library tambahan: `jimp` atau `sharp`.

```bash
npm install jimp
# atau
npm install sharp
```

Otomatis dipake pas kirim media  thumbnail digenerate otomatis.

## Re-upload Media Kedaluwarsa

WhatsApp hapus media lama dari server. Kalo mau akses lagi, perlu re-upload dari perangkat lain yang masih punya file-nya.

```ts
await sock.updateMediaMessage(msg)
```

## Media Encodings

| Tipe Media | Format |
|---|---|
| Image | JPEG/PNG → dienkripsi AES-256-GCM |
| Video | MP4 → dienkripsi |
| Audio | OGG/MP4 → dienkripsi |
| Document | PDF/DOC dll → dienkripsi |
| Sticker | WEBP → dienkripsi |

Semua media dienkripsi end-to-end pake Signal Protocol sebelum dikirim ke server WA.
